div.p: How biological data are transformed - data objects and their backing files
Cluster scope: only primary proteins are submitted for InterProScan / pyTMHMM. Alternative isoforms are not annotated.
Granularity: transcript/protein/exon data are per species. Isoform alignment is within-species; primary MSA is cross-species.
Evidence status: candidate regions are generic exploratory (never validated). FGFR2 replaces them with validated IIIb/IIIc evidence.
